construction.adds: Only existing authorized partial completion paths; no new automatic top-up or resize sale.
construction.critical_dependency: Current engine clamps retained rank buffer to target count. Isolated future research adapter must separate capacity from retention; never widen exits when capacity rises.
construction.equity: C1 trading equity equals sum of independent sleeve marked securities plus cash. Excludes MSTR and all unadmitted holdings including existing Core MRNA.
construction.funding: Actual remaining research sleeve cash, less fees and reserved purchases; aggregate research cash ceiling. No historical Schwab cash is invented.
construction.new_entry_floor: Require lower-bound allocation, allowing less than one share of rounding deficit, and preserve the $750 normalized-model minimum trade: $187.50/$375/$187.50 for initial $25k/$50k/$25k actual-dollar books. Otherwise skip.
construction.ordering: Existing exits first under production precedence, then authorized partial completions, then new names by source rank, symbol, base/cooldown15/sector40. No hypothetical sale funding before simulated execution.
construction.queue: Nine original source ranks; do not compress ranks or backfill beyond nine after exclusions.
construction.rank_7_9: Eligible entry queue does not grant retention beyond rank-six threshold after existing minimum hold. Measure resulting churn.
construction.restrictions: Preserve one selected name per sector/issuer in screen; sleeve two-name sector limit, 50/50/40 percent sector caps, issuer ceiling, SCHW/MSTR restrictions, liquidity, price, events, gap, cooldown, timing and risk checks. Unknown evidence never passes.
construction.rounding: Floor whole actual shares per sleeve; consolidate broker presentation only after ownership allocation, never transfer historical sleeve interests.
construction.sizing_dollars: p(r)*E_s at decision close; aggregate issuer exposure cannot exceed high*sum(E_s); target dollars fixed into next open
construction.weights: initial only; no rebalance or inter-sleeve transfers

data.date_selection: Use exact target interval only when coverage passes; otherwise freeze new coverage-derived dates before any outcome calculation. Never select dates by returns.
data.label: Retrospective independently reconstructed research, not recovered production history
data.macd: Independent research may causally recompute through pinned entryTiming algorithm and exact lookback/initialization; label reconstructed. Exact production replay requires accepted canonical timing.
data.membership: Stable security IDs, dated effective changes, historical additions/removals and delistings; removal retains valuation/exit evidence for holdings.
data.missing: Missing provenance blocks certification; missing sessions cannot be filled, carried or replaced with accounting fixtures. IPO history follows exact current eligibility. Unavailable event evidence is not event-clear.
data.primary_source_track: independent point-in-time dataset; recovered originals optional separate track
data.raw_capture: Read-only acquisition into research workspace; raw bytes immutable with URL excluding credentials, retrievedAt UTC, entitlement, license, request parameters, byte count, SHA256, provider methodology and publication/effective timestamps.
data.revision_policy: Never overwrite raw inputs. Corrections create new version and force re-freeze before results.
data.source_limit: FMP membership history and adjusted bars alone do not establish dated sectors, event history, delisting returns or historical data vintages. A second entitled source or contemporaneous official records is required.
universes: historical Nasdaq-100 separately if complete; never substitute Nasdaq Composite without new preregistration
data.verification: Two independent origins for membership changes, corporate-action/delisting outcomes and classification exceptions; same-vendor endpoints are not independent. Causal availability of inputs must be independently reviewed.

execution.account_facts: All production historical fills and cash remain unchanged; research fills exist only in isolated hypothetical ledgers
execution.decision_time: After completed regular-session close using only then-available inputs
execution.fees: No actual account fills substituted in retrospective simulations; identical modeled costs across arms
execution.live_limit: Completed-session research cannot reproduce 120-second quote freshness or live account/manual authority without captured receipts
execution.trade_time: Next regular-session open; retain existing stop/breaker precedence and gap-through-stop treatment
execution.valuation: Same adjusted price basis for signals and simulator OHLC/positions; explicit corporate-action reconciliation. No double-counted dividends. Marks at each close; no forced terminal liquidation; report common estimated liquidation-cost sensitivity separately.

execution_status.dataset: NOT ESTABLISHED: shared proxy transport unavailable for independent FMP source as well as Blob
execution_status.preregistration_refinements: Before historical results: corrected normalized minimum-trade dollar conversion and implemented reporting/validation metadata. No empirical parameter optimization.
execution_status.research_runner: Implemented isolated runner; no historical dataset qualified and independent adapter parity approval remains required.
execution_status.spec_change_rule: Any material change creates v2 with reason and new hash before results; never overwrite v1.
execution_status.status: Final preregistration before any historical evaluation; mechanics-only tests excluded from investment evidence.

research_questions: Incremental effects of recent returns, MACD confirmation, deterioration exits and profit giveback
Rank-based sizing with independently accounted sleeves
Nine-name entry consideration subject to unchanged restrictions
Cash utilization, costs, turnover, opportunity loss and holding-age effects

risk_and_holding.deployment: Momentum-removal arms are diagnostic only, not deployable trading proposals
risk_and_holding.holding_period_analysis: Descriptive attribution by 0-4,5-29,30-59,60+ completed sessions. No new minimum-hold variants; count risk exits before day 30 and queue/rank-blocked opportunities without inventing counterfactual gains.
risk_and_holding.unchanged: 14 percent initial stops, 12 percent sleeve breaker, 10/15-session cooldowns, rank thresholds 6/9, issuer/sector limits, ordinary 30-session holding rule, 252-session time exit, universe/delisting handling, early/profit-rank confirmations. October branches differ only in named diagnostic ablations.

statistics.holdout: All reused historical data labeled exploratory; no sealed holdout or independent-universe claim from overlapping dates
metrics: mean median and percentile cash weight
statistics.multiplicity: 11 non-control comparisons; Holm family-wise alpha .05 on primary net daily-return differential tests at 12 bps. Costs 25/50 bps fixed stress reports, no selective cost-based winner. Sharpe and CAGR CIs descriptive.
statistics.opportunity_cost: Pairwise actual full-path equity differences and blocked candidate counts; descriptive 5/20-session forward candidate returns are labeled diagnostics, never added to portfolio P&L or used for selection
statistics.promotion: No automatic promotion; report all arms including negative and inconclusive results.
statistics.sharpe: sqrt(252)*mean(daily returns)/sample std; zero risk-free rate explicitly, undefined if zero variance
statistics.subperiods: Fixed calendar-year and predefined drawdown/volatility regimes using lagged benchmark information; no best-window selection
statistics.turnover: annualized sum(abs(executed notional))/mean equity; report two-sided convention
statistics.uncertainty: Paired stationary time-block bootstrap, expected block length 20 sessions, 10000 replicates, seed 20261016. Same sampled dates across all arms and costs. Preserve per-arm return vectors; dependence and path-dependent-strategy limitations disclosed. Also report descriptive paired CAGR, Sharpe and drawdown difference intervals.
